name: papermark
description: Create data rooms, share documents with access controls, and inspect document view analytics in Papermark.

interface.longDescription: Use Papermark to organize data rooms for fundraising, deals, and due diligence; create protected document links; and inspect document view analytics. Connect your Papermark account to use the bundled remote MCP tools. Available actions and data depend on your account permissions and the tools exposed by the server. Includes guidance on documents, links, data rooms, and analytics, plus a CLI skill for environments with shell access and Node.js 24 or newer. The CLI requires separate authentication.
defaultPrompt: Share this pitch deck as a password-protected link.
Create a data room for the Acme deal and add these documents.
Who viewed the deck I sent last week, and for how long?
